THEINVENTOR-BONK.description: At the start of each turn, deal [blue]5[/blue] damage to a random enemy.

THEINVENTOR-CRACK.description: The first time an enemy loses HP each turn, ALL enemies lose that much HP.

THEINVENTOR-WALL_OF_ICE.title: Wall of Ice
